content: Quality over quantity: 3-5 (up to ~10) polished projects beat many shallow ones. Avoid tutorial/CRUD clones. Tailor project selection to target role. 84% of employers want live working demos not just repos. Pin ~6 GitHub repos with good READMEs. Mobile responsiveness and <2s load are baseline; broken links/demos are the most damaging failure. Make contact obvious (resume + email one click away). Portfolio requires ongoing maintenance; 93% of hiring managers will look at a portfolio if given one, but portfolio alone doesn't overcome weak project substance.
